one_line: Chishti Sufi master of Pakpattan whose vernacular verses shaped devotional poetry and hospitality networks across medieval Punjab.

appearance.age_look: Late 60s, slight but resilient frame, with the calm presence of a seasoned mystic.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm wheatish Punjabi complexion, medium-length white beard neatly combed, gentle lines at the eyes, straight nose, thoughtful calm gaze, default expression a soft, compassionate half-smile that feels quietly intense.
appearance.hair: White hair, kept short and mostly hidden under a simple off-white cotton turban wound low and snug, with one narrow tail of cloth hanging over the left shoulder like a casual wrap.
appearance.costume: A long, loose, ankle-length kurta of undyed off-white cotton (simple plain weave, no embroidery), over it a light brown woolen shawl worn diagonally from right shoulder to left hip, tied subtly at the waist; straight-cut loose churidar-style trousers in muted beige; simple dark brown leather sandals; a plain wooden tasbih (prayer beads) looped around his left wrist; the overall look echoes 13th-century Punjab Chishti ascetic dress: modest, practical, and free of ornament.
appearance.signature: A well-used walking staff of dark wood about his own height, top smoothed by years of use, carried upright in his right hand, with a small cloth pouch for travelers’ food tied near the upper third of the staff.

ref_desc: Baba Farid appears as a late-60s Punjabi Sufi with an oval wheatish face, neat white beard, off-white turban, off-white cotton kurta, light brown wool shawl, beige trousers, dark brown sandals, and a dark wooden staff with a small cloth food pouch, in soft earth tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Baba Farid Ganj-i-Shakar: an elderly yet resilient Chishti Sufi from 13th-century Punjab, late 60s, oval wheatish face, gentle lines, calm eyes, and a neatly combed medium-length white beard with a soft, compassionate half-smile. His white hair is short and mostly hidden beneath a simple off-white cotton turban wound low and snug, with a narrow tail of cloth draping over his left shoulder. He wears an ankle-length, loose off-white cotton kurta with plain weave and no ornament, straight-cut loose beige churidar-style trousers, and simple dark brown leather sandals. Over his kurta he has a light brown woolen shawl wrapped diagonally from right shoulder to left hip, lightly tied at the waist to hint at ascetic practicality, with a plain wooden tasbih looped around his left wrist. In his right hand he carries a dark wooden walking staff about his height, the top smoothed from years of use, with a small cloth pouch tied near the upper third to evoke food carried for guests and travelers. Use a soft, earthy palette of off-white, light brown, beige, dark brown, and muted warm sand tones, and show front, side, and back views to clearly present his face, turban, garments, sandals, staff, and overall humble, hospitable aura in clean shonen-anime linework.
